posts.hook: You're not lazy, your brain is just fried from cheap dopamine.

posts.caption:
Your brain is a supercomputer being used to scroll through 15-second cat videos. 🧠 Stop the leak. Reset your focus. Real wins take time, not swipes. ⚡️

Fact: The average person touches their phone 2,617 times a day. Are you average? 📵

Ready to take back your mind? Drop a 'FIRE' if you're starting a dopamine detox today. 👇

posts.hook: Marcus Aurelius didn't have a phone, but he knew exactly how to handle your burnout.
posts.visual_prompt: DARK LUXURY style, deep blacks, gold accents, editorial composition. A marble bust of Marcus Aurelius, partially shadowed. A single gold laurel wreath rests on the head. Minimalist lighting. Text overlay: 'CONTROL THE INNER' in elegant gold serif font.
posts.caption:
'You have power over your mind—not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.' — Marcus Aurelius. 🏛️

The digital world is designed to steal your peace. Stoicism is the firewall. 🛡️ Don't react. Observe.

Fact: In 170 AD, Aurelius wrote 'Meditations' while leading a war—reminding us that external chaos is no excuse for internal noise.

How do you stay calm in the chaos? Share your secret below. 🙏
